useCases.title: Open for review
mainFlow: 1. Opening a request for review moves it to Under Review and records the reviewing officer.

useCases.title: No automatic approval outside fast-track
mainFlow: 1. There is no automatic approval; every booking request is reviewed by a berth officer before it can become Approved (except the fast-track rule in F003).

useCases.title: Review screen highlights dimension exceedance
mainFlow: 1. The review screen shows the vessel's dimensions next to the berth's limits and highlights any exceedance in red.

useCases.title: Last five bookings of the same vessel (SHAPE-CHANGING GAP — see F004-Q1)
mainFlow: 1. workshop-notes.md session 3: the review screen must show the last five bookings of the same vessel.
2. ADOPTED (Ruling R8): added as a read-only sub-list, most recent first, on the officer review screen wireframe.

useCases.title: Three decision outcomes
mainFlow: 1. An approval decision has one of three outcomes: Approved, Rejected or Returned for Information.

useCases.title: Rejection reason is conditionally required (IMAGE-ONLY RULE — see F004-Q2)
mainFlow: 1. The data dictionary (ch36) marks ApprovalDecision.Reason as Optional.
2. The officer-review-screen prototype screenshot shows a validation message: 'REJECTION REASON IS REQUIRED WHEN OUTCOME IS REJECTED' — this rule exists ONLY in the image.
3. ADOPTED (Ruling R6): keep Reason Optional at the field level; add an explicit microflow validation requiring it when Outcome = Rejected.

useCases.title: Return for information — one resubmission
mainFlow: 1. A request Returned for Information goes back to the agent, who may amend and resubmit it once.

useCases.title: Harbour Master override of a Rejected decision
mainFlow: 1. Only the Harbour Master may override a Rejected decision, and the override is recorded with a reason.
validations: Override action restricted to HarbourMaster role

microflows.name: ACT_ApprovalDecision_Decide
microflows.purpose: Records outcome; enforces Reason-required-on-Reject and Harbour-Master-only override.

pages.name: OfficerReview_Decide
pages.purpose: Review screen: dimension check, last-5-bookings panel, decide

openQuestions.answer: Added to the review screen wireframe (Ruling R8).
